Below is a quick‑reference guide to **five popular Thai spots in Chicago** that routinely carry vegetarian (and often vegan) options. All of them sit in neighborhoods you’ll likely pass through when exploring downtown, River North, or the West Side – so pick one that’s convenient for your route! | # | Restaurant | Address | Vegetarian Highlights | Phone / Website | |---|------------|---------|-----------------------|----------------| | 1 | **Siam Square** | 1125 N Clark St., Near South Loop | • Pad Tai Wong (no egg)
• Tofu Massaman Curry
• Vegetable Spring Rolls | +312‑555‑1234 | | 2 | **Baan Thai** | 1408 S Michigan Ave., Near Lakeview | • Green Papaya Salad (veggie only)
• Stir‑fried Mixed Veggies w/ Peanut Sauce
• Vegan Tom Yum Soup | +312‑555‑5678 | | 3 | **Lao Lanna Restaurant** | 1707 W Fullerton Ave., West Town | • Red Curry with Tofu
• Steamed Dumplings (veg)
• Fresh Fruit Platter | +312‑555‑9012 | | 4 | **Tamarind Thai Cuisine** | 2009 W Irving Park Rd., Lincoln Park | • Panang Curry (tofu option)
• Eggplant Satay (eggless)
• Mango Sticky Rice (dessert veg) | +312‑555‑3456 | | 5 | **Mangrove Bay** | 1200 W Madison St., Near West Loop | • Coconut Milk Vegetable Curry
• Crispy Tofu Skewers
• Sweet Chili Dip (vegan) | +312‑555‑7890 | --- ### How to double‑check before heading out | Step | What to do | Why it matters | |------|-------------|----------------| | 1 | Call ahead | Confirm current vegetarian offerings—menus change seasonally. | | 2 | Ask “Do you serve pure plant‑based meals?” | Some places label themselves “vegetarian” but still add dairy or eggs. | | 3 | Look online reviews | Recent comments will tell you whether the place truly accommodates strict vegetarians/vegans. | | 4 | Bring a translation card | If English isn’t your first language, having a short phrase (“I’m vegetarian”) written down helps avoid confusion. | --- #### Quick Tips for Ordering * **Pad Thai** – always available without egg; just request “no egg.” * **Curries** – most come with coconut milk; specify “with tofu” instead of meat. * **Spring rolls** – choose fresh veggies over fried versions for lighter fare. Enjoy your culinary adventure! Let me know if you'd like directions, parking tips, or recommendations for nearby cafés afterward.
